whatsappMessage:
Hi Golden Flavour Team,

I noticed your restaurant has an impressive 1.4K+ reviews on Boring Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page for local diners.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/goldenflavour

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Golden Flavour Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Golden Flavour in Orchid Mall, Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and your strong 1.4K+ review showcase right on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, pricing, aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
